changes: Updated repo-local init so default initialization installs Koala management assets only; starter business templates under src/core, src/shells, and tests are now behind --starter / --with-template. scanRoot detection now uses the pre-init project shape, and entrypoint smoke covers default, starter aliases, Python no-src, pre-existing src, and init help contracts. README now scopes the entrypoint smoke promise to repo-local/local-wrapper paths rather than stale global koala installs.
usage: Use default management-only init with `node packages/main/dist/cli.js init <dir>` or `node bin/koala.js init <dir>`. Use `--starter` or `--with-template` only when you intentionally want the legacy starter src/tests templates.
expectedOutcome: Default init shows Koala management assets only and does not create src/core, src/shells, or tests. Python no-src init keeps language=python and scanRoot=. without creating src. Starter init prints Starter template: enabled and creates src/core/app.ts, src/shells/cli/main.ts, tests, and scanRoot=src.
actualTranscript: Manual repo-local transcript: default checks {scanRoot: ., hasSrc:false, hasTests:false}; python checks {language:python, scanRoot: ., hasSrc:false, hasTests:false}; starter checks {scanRoot:src, hasApp:true, hasCli:true, hasTests:true}; starter output includes Starter template: enabled (--starter / --with-template). Full transcript diff is in .koala/story/actives/B-6c80/evidence/transcript-diff.md.
outcomeDiff: No mismatch. Actual output matches the expected management-only default, Python no-src scanRoot, and explicit starter behavior.
limitations: Bare global `koala` may still show old help until the package containing this change is published or installed; README now explicitly scopes smoke guarantees to repo-local entrypoints and generated local wrapper.
pitfalls: Two review cycles caught important process gaps: test evidence must be refreshed after any HEAD rewrite, and normal-channel implementation commits need author=koala-implementer. Also avoid parallel finding_resolve because concurrent writes can lose one status update.
